meanings.en: in a way that is large or important enough to be noticed
meanings.exampleEn: Sales have increased significantly this year.
meanings.exampleTr: Satışlar bu yıl önemli ölçüde arttı.

meanings.en: to be a sign of something; to mean
meanings.exampleEn: A red light signifies that you must stop.
meanings.exampleTr: Kırmızı ışık durmanız gerektiğini belirtir.

meanings.tr: gümüş çatal bıçak takımı, gümüş sofra takımı
meanings.en: forks, knives and spoons, especially those made of silver
meanings.exampleEn: She polished the silverware before the dinner party.
meanings.exampleTr: Akşam yemeği partisinden önce gümüş takımları parlattı.

meanings.en: the process of making something easier to do or understand
meanings.exampleEn: The new rules are a welcome simplification of the old system.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni kurallar, eski sistemin memnuniyet verici bir basitleştirmesidir.

meanings.en: happening or done at exactly the same time
meanings.exampleEn: The explosion caused a simultaneous power failure across the city.
meanings.exampleTr: Patlama, şehir genelinde eş zamanlı bir elektrik kesintisine yol açtı.

meanings.en: from a time in the past until now or until a later time
meanings.exampleEn: He left home in 2010 and we have not seen him since.
meanings.exampleTr: 2010'da evden ayrıldı ve o zamandan beri onu görmedik.

meanings.en: the quality of being honest and truly meaning what you say
meanings.exampleEn: I do not doubt the sincerity of her apology.
meanings.exampleTr: Özrünün içtenliğinden şüphe etmiyorum.

meanings.tr: görümce, baldız, yenge (eşin kız kardeşi veya erkek kardeşin eşi)
meanings.en: the sister of your husband or wife, or your brother's wife
meanings.exampleEn: My sister-in-law is coming to stay with us next week.
meanings.exampleTr: Baldızım gelecek hafta bizde kalmaya gelecek.

meanings.en: a short narrow board with wheels that you stand on and ride
meanings.exampleEn: He rode his skateboard all the way to school.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaykayıyla ta okula kadar gitti.

meanings.en: a person who rides a skateboard
meanings.exampleEn: The skateboarder performed an impressive jump over the steps.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaykaycı, basamakların üzerinden etkileyici bir atlayış yaptı.

meanings.en: to make a quick rough drawing of something
meanings.exampleEn: She sketched the old castle while sitting in the park.
meanings.exampleTr: Parkta otururken eski kalenin taslağını çizdi.

meanings.en: having the ability and experience to do something well
meanings.exampleEn: He is a highly skilled carpenter.
meanings.exampleTr: O çok yetenekli bir marangozdur.

meanings.en: good at doing something that needs ability or training
meanings.exampleEn: The surgeon's skillful hands saved the patient's life.
meanings.exampleTr: Cerrahın hünerli elleri hastanın hayatını kurtardı.

meanings.en: in a way that shows great ability or skill
meanings.exampleEn: She skillfully repaired the broken watch.
meanings.exampleTr: Bozuk saati ustalıkla tamir etti.

meanings.tr: göz gezdirmek, çabucak okumak; köpüğünü almak
meanings.en: to read something quickly to get the main idea
meanings.exampleEn: I only had time to skim the report before the meeting.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplantıdan önce rapora sadece göz gezdirecek vaktim oldu.

meanings.en: to not do something or leave it out
meanings.exampleEn: He decided to skip breakfast because he was late.
meanings.exampleTr: Geç kaldığı için kahvaltıyı atlamaya karar verdi.

meanings.en: a small brown bird known for singing while flying high in the sky
meanings.exampleEn: A skylark sang sweetly above the open fields.
meanings.exampleTr: Açık tarlaların üzerinde bir tarla kuşu tatlı tatlı şakıdı.

meanings.en: toward the sky; upward
meanings.exampleEn: The rocket shot skyward in a cloud of smoke.
meanings.exampleTr: Roket bir duman bulutu içinde gökyüzüne doğru fırladı.

meanings.en: to shut something with force and a loud noise
meanings.exampleEn: She slammed the door angrily as she left.
meanings.exampleTr: Çıkarken kapıyı öfkeyle çarptı.

meanings.en: very informal words used by a particular group of people
meanings.exampleEn: Teenagers often use slang that adults do not understand.
meanings.exampleTr: Gençler genellikle yetişkinlerin anlamadığı argo kullanır.

meanings.en: a hit with the flat part of the hand
meanings.exampleEn: She gave him a slap across the face.
meanings.exampleTr: Yüzüne bir tokat attı.

meanings.en: a mark (/) used in writing, or a long cut
meanings.exampleEn: Put a slash between the two dates.
meanings.exampleTr: İki tarihin arasına bir eğik çizgi koy.

meanings.en: the killing of many people, or of animals for food
meanings.exampleEn: The war led to the slaughter of thousands of civilians.
meanings.exampleTr: Savaş, binlerce sivilin katliamına yol açtı.

meanings.en: small in degree; not important
meanings.exampleEn: There was a slight change in the weather.
meanings.exampleTr: Havada hafif bir değişiklik vardı.

meanings.en: a small, thin piece of something
meanings.exampleEn: She cut a thin sliver of cheese for the sandwich.
meanings.exampleTr: Sandviç için ince bir dilim peynir kesti.

meanings.en: done carelessly and without attention to detail
meanings.exampleEn: His sloppy work full of mistakes annoyed the teacher.
meanings.exampleTr: Hatalarla dolu özensiz çalışması öğretmeni rahatsız etti.

meanings.en: to break something violently into pieces
meanings.exampleEn: The ball smashed the window into tiny pieces.
meanings.exampleTr: Top, pencereyi paramparça etti.

meanings.en: a tall chimney that lets out smoke from a factory or ship
meanings.exampleEn: Thick black smoke poured from the factory's smokestack.
meanings.exampleTr: Fabrikanın bacasından yoğun siyah duman çıkıyordu.

meanings.tr: şak diye kırmak, ani sesle kırılmak
meanings.en: to break suddenly with a sharp sound
meanings.exampleEn: The dry branch snapped under his foot.
meanings.exampleTr: Kuru dal ayağının altında şak diye kırıldı.

meanings.en: to go somewhere quietly and secretly
meanings.exampleEn: He tried to sneak out of the house without being seen.
meanings.exampleTr: Görünmeden evden gizlice çıkmaya çalıştı.

meanings.en: a scornful expression or remark showing contempt
meanings.exampleEn: There was a cruel sneer on his face as he spoke.
meanings.exampleTr: Konuşurken yüzünde acımasız bir alaycı gülümseme vardı.

meanings.en: to breathe air in through the nose in a way that makes a sound
meanings.exampleEn: The dog sniffed the ground looking for food.
meanings.exampleTr: Köpek yiyecek ararken yeri kokladı.

meanings.en: a snorting sound made by a sleeping person while breathing
meanings.exampleEn: His loud snore kept the whole family awake.
meanings.exampleTr: Yüksek horultusu bütün aileyi uyanık tuttu.

meanings.en: a ball of snow pressed together, often thrown for fun
meanings.exampleEn: The children threw a snowball at each other in the park.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar parkta birbirlerine kartopu attılar.

meanings.en: used to show that you do not think a name or title is suitable
meanings.exampleEn: These so-called experts gave us terrible advice.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu sözde uzmanlar bize berbat tavsiyeler verdi.

meanings.en: a period of lying in or being left in water
meanings.exampleEn: After the long hike, she enjoyed a hot soak in the bath.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun yürüyüşten sonra küvette sıcak bir banyonun keyfini çıkardı.

meanings.en: completely wet, especially with water
meanings.exampleEn: We got soaked walking home in the heavy rain.
meanings.exampleTr: Şiddetli yağmurda eve yürürken sırılsıklam olduk.

meanings.en: extremely wet
meanings.exampleEn: Her clothes were soaking after she fell into the lake.
meanings.exampleTr: Göle düştükten sonra kıyafetleri sırılsıklamdı.

meanings.en: to rise high in the air, or to increase quickly
meanings.exampleEn: The eagle soared high above the mountains.
meanings.exampleTr: Kartal dağların çok yukarısında süzülerek uçtu.

meanings.en: to cry noisily while taking sudden breaths
meanings.exampleEn: The little girl sobbed when she lost her toy.
meanings.exampleTr: Küçük kız oyuncağını kaybedince hıçkıra hıçkıra ağladı.

meanings.en: friendly and enjoying being with other people
meanings.exampleEn: She is a sociable person who makes friends easily.
meanings.exampleTr: O, kolayca arkadaş edinen sosyal bir insandır.

meanings.en: to spend time with other people in a friendly way
meanings.exampleEn: He doesn't socialize much because he prefers to stay home.
meanings.exampleTr: Evde kalmayı tercih ettiği için pek sosyalleşmez.

meanings.en: the quality of being soft to touch or gentle
meanings.exampleEn: She loved the softness of the new blanket.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni battaniyenin yumuşaklığını çok sevdi.

meanings.en: the top layer of earth in which plants grow
meanings.exampleEn: This rich soil is perfect for growing vegetables.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu verimli toprak sebze yetiştirmek için mükemmel.

meanings.en: relating to or using energy from the sun
meanings.exampleEn: They installed solar panels on the roof of their house.
meanings.exampleTr: Evlerinin çatısına güneş panelleri kurdular.

meanings.en: the quality of being strong, firm and not easily broken
meanings.exampleEn: The solidity of the old bridge impressed the engineers.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski köprünün sağlamlığı mühendisleri etkiledi.

meanings.en: a speech in a play in which a character talks alone to themselves
meanings.exampleEn: Hamlet's famous soliloquy begins with 'To be or not to be'.
meanings.exampleTr: Hamlet'in ünlü monoloğu 'Olmak ya da olmamak' ile başlar.

meanings.en: done by one person alone
meanings.exampleEn: She made her first solo flight at the age of eighteen.
meanings.exampleTr: İlk solo uçuşunu on sekiz yaşında yaptı.

meanings.en: to some degree but not very much
meanings.exampleEn: The results were somewhat disappointing.
meanings.exampleTr: Sonuçlar biraz hayal kırıklığı yarattı.

meanings.en: the husband of your daughter
meanings.exampleEn: Her son-in-law helped them move into the new house.
meanings.exampleTr: Damadı, yeni eve taşınmalarına yardım etti.

meanings.en: a poem of fourteen lines with a fixed rhyme pattern
meanings.exampleEn: Shakespeare wrote a famous sonnet about love.
meanings.exampleTr: Shakespeare aşk hakkında ünlü bir sone yazdı.

meanings.en: clever and complicated, or having refined tastes
meanings.exampleEn: The factory uses sophisticated technology to detect faults.
meanings.exampleTr: Fabrika, arızaları tespit etmek için gelişmiş teknoloji kullanıyor.

meanings.en: healthy, in good condition, or based on good judgement
meanings.exampleEn: The lawyer gave us some sound advice about the contract.
meanings.exampleTr: Avukat bize sözleşme hakkında sağlam tavsiyeler verdi.

meanings.en: the recorded music from a film or television programme
meanings.exampleEn: The movie's soundtrack became hugely popular.
meanings.exampleTr: Filmin müziği son derece popüler oldu.

meanings.en: toward the south
meanings.exampleEn: The birds flew southward as winter approached.
meanings.exampleTr: Kış yaklaşırken kuşlar güneye doğru uçtu.

meanings.en: relating to the former Soviet Union or its people
meanings.exampleEn: The museum displayed many objects from the Soviet era.
meanings.exampleTr: Müze, Sovyet döneminden birçok nesneyi sergiledi.

meanings.en: a bean that is used for food and to make oil
meanings.exampleEn: Farmers in this region grow large fields of soybean.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu bölgedeki çiftçiler geniş soya fasulyesi tarlaları yetiştirir.

meanings.en: a place where people relax with treatments and mineral water
meanings.exampleEn: They spent the weekend relaxing at a luxury spa.
meanings.exampleTr: Hafta sonunu lüks bir spa merkezinde dinlenerek geçirdiler.

meanings.tr: kapsamak, uzanmak (bir süre veya alan boyunca)
meanings.en: to extend across a period of time or an area
meanings.exampleEn: Her career spanned more than forty years.
meanings.exampleTr: Kariyeri kırk yıldan fazla bir süreyi kapsadı.

meanings.en: extra and available to use when needed
meanings.exampleEn: Always keep a spare tire in the trunk of your car.
meanings.exampleTr: Arabanın bagajında her zaman yedek bir lastik bulundur.

meanings.en: a rib of pork with most of the meat cut away
meanings.exampleEn: We ordered a plate of grilled spareribs at the restaurant.
meanings.exampleTr: Restoranda bir tabak ızgara kaburga söyledik.

meanings.en: a small flash of fire or light
meanings.exampleEn: A single spark from the fire started the forest blaze.
meanings.exampleTr: Ateşten çıkan tek bir kıvılcım orman yangınını başlattı.

meanings.en: shining brightly with flashes of light, or fizzy
meanings.exampleEn: The lake looked beautiful with its sparkling water.
meanings.exampleTr: Göl, pırıl pırıl suyuyla çok güzel görünüyordu.

meanings.en: a small brown and grey bird common in many places
meanings.exampleEn: A sparrow built its nest under the roof.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir serçe çatının altına yuvasını yaptı.

meanings.en: a special skill, or a product a place is famous for
meanings.exampleEn: Fresh seafood is the specialty of this restaurant.
meanings.exampleTr: Taze deniz ürünleri bu restoranın spesiyalitesidir.

meanings.en: a group of animals or plants that are similar and can breed
meanings.exampleEn: Many species of birds visit this island every spring.
meanings.exampleTr: Her ilkbahar bu adayı birçok kuş türü ziyaret eder.

meanings.en: for a particular reason, person or thing; exactly
meanings.exampleEn: This course was designed specifically for beginners.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu kurs özellikle yeni başlayanlar için tasarlandı.

meanings.en: to state something clearly and exactly
meanings.exampleEn: Please specify the size and colour you want.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen istediğiniz boyutu ve rengi belirtin.

meanings.en: an impressive or unusual sight or public show
meanings.exampleEn: The fireworks were a magnificent spectacle.
meanings.exampleTr: Havai fişekler muhteşem bir gösteriydi.

meanings.en: a driver who goes faster than the legal speed limit
meanings.exampleEn: The police officer stopped the speeder on the highway.
meanings.exampleTr: Polis memuru, otoyolda hız sınırını aşan sürücüyü durdurdu.
